job.job_description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AWS Bedrock to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building GenAI applications, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, integrating foundation models through AWS Bedrock, and deploying scalable AI solutions on AWS cloud.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions using Python and AWS Bedrock.
Build and optimize LLM-powered applications, chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI copilots.
Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using vector databases and embedding models.
Integrate and orchestrate foundation models available through Amazon Bedrock.
Create AI agents and agentic workflows for business process automation.
Develop RESTful APIs and microservices for AI model consumption.
Implement prompt engineering strategies for improved model accuracy and performance.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI models for enterprise use cases.
Design scalable AI pipelines using AWS services such as Lambda, S3, API Gateway, ECS, EKS, and Step Functions.
Collaborate with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to identify AI opportunities.
Ensure AI solutions adhere to security, governance, and compliance requirements.
Monitor model performance, latency, and operational efficiency in production environments.
